subject: AS A RESPONSE MEASURE TO THE DECISION OF SWEDISH AVIATION
text:
U1095/26 NOTAMR U0681/26
Q)UUWV/QOAXX/IV/BO/A/000/999/5535N03716E999
A)UUUU B)2608250601 C)2611252359 EST
E)AS A RESPONSE MEASURE TO THE DECISION OF SWEDISH AVIATION
AUTHORITIES TO PROHIBIT ALL ACFT REGISTERED IN RUSSIAN FEDERATION
AND ALSO ALL ACFT NOT REGISTERED IN RUSSIAN FEDERATION BUT OWNED,
CHARTERED OR OTHERWISE CONTROLLED BY RUSSIAN NATURAL OR LEGAL
PERSON, ENTITY OR BODY, FROM ENTERING, EXITING OR OVERFLYING
SWEDISH AIRSPACE, EXCEPT HUMANITARIAN, SAR AND LEASED ACFT RETURN
FLIGHTS WITH THE PERMISSION OF SWEDISH AUTHORITIES AND IN CASE
OF EMERGENCY LANDING OR EMERGENCY OVERFLIGHT, AS PER AIP SUP
108/2024,
AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION HEREBY INFORM THAT ALL
AIRCRAFT OWNED, CHARTERED, OPERATED OR OTHERWISE CONTROLLED BY
SWEDISH CITIZENS, AND ALL ACFT OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR
CERTIFICATE (AOC) ISSUED BY SWEDISH AUTHORITIES ARE PROHIBITED
FROM ENTERING, EXITING OR OVERFLYING THE AIRSPACE OF THE RUSSIAN
FEDERATION, EXC ACFT IN EMERGENCY, HUMANITARIAN, SANITARY FLT AND
CASES WHEN SPECIAL PERMISSION FOR OPERATING FLT GRANTED BY FEDERAL
AIR TRANSPORT AGENCY OR MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF RUSSIA, AS
APPROPRIATE.
